subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should those entries be hidden or neutral instead?
rationale: The remaining false-Missing symptom overlaps a file metadata boundary that current main intentionally keeps behind fs-safe containment, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/security semantics.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral, and the rail avoids presenting them as missing workspace files.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The gateway may return outside-root existence metadata only with explicit tests, documentation, and security-boundary acceptance.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral, and the rail avoids presenting them as missing workspace files.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and fs-safe boundary work makes this the strongest owner for the file metadata decision.
